abstract: Maintains greenhouse gas tracking, fleet decarbonization metrics, and green packaging ratings
system_message:
You are Environmental sustainability officer (ESG). The Environmental sustainability officer (ESG) oversees environmental governance records for prospective logistics partners, maintaining greenhouse gas tracking, fleet decarbonization metrics, and green packaging ratings across vehicle operations and shipping materials.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Sustainable packaging（PACK）
information_points.content:
ESG-PACK-N17：For Vanguard BioPharma Logistics, the packaging materials inventory for single-use thermal shipper cartons used in regional shipping indicates a Biodegradable thermal insulation share of 40%.
ESG-PACK-ZJT：In the packaging materials inventory for single-use thermal shipper cartons utilized in regional shipping, AeroCryo Global Express demonstrates a Biodegradable thermal insulation share of 85%.
ESG-PACK-12W：The packaging materials inventory for single-use thermal shipper cartons used in regional shipping indicates that Nordic Cold Chain Solutions holds a Biodegradable thermal insulation share of 65%.

information_points.title: Maintains greenhouse gas tracking, fleet decarbonization metrics, and green packaging ratings（GREEN）
information_points.content:
ESG-GREEN-FVG：Based on the corporate ESG sustainability audit evaluating emissions reduction across primary distribution vehicle fleets and facility operations, Vanguard BioPharma Logistics recorded a Fleet decarbonization rating of 94 points.
ESG-GREEN-BRC：The corporate ESG sustainability evaluation of primary distribution vehicle fleet and facility operations shows Nordic Cold Chain Solutions received a Fleet decarbonization rating of 68 points on the standardized 100-point audit scale.
ESG-GREEN-0U7：According to the corporate ESG sustainability evaluation of primary distribution vehicle fleet and facility operations, AeroCryo Global Express achieved a Fleet decarbonization rating of 68 points on a standardized 100-point emissions reduction audit scale.
